# Curriculum Vitae

## Professional Summary

Commercial Property & Casualty insurance professional with experience in underwriting, risk evaluation, pricing, and business decision-making. Currently expanding technical expertise through graduate coursework in Big Data and Cloud Analytics for Business.

My professional and academic experience combines business analysis with emerging technologies including data analytics, cloud computing, data visualization, and machine learning.

## Professional Experience

### Commercial P&C Underwriting

My underwriting experience includes evaluating commercial accounts, analyzing financial information, reviewing loss history, assessing exposures, developing pricing, and working with agents to structure appropriate insurance programs.

Key areas of experience include:

- Commercial underwriting
- Risk analysis and evaluation
- Financial analysis
- Loss analysis
- Pricing and portfolio management
- Business-to-business communication
- Property and casualty insurance
- Data-driven decision making
